contact_point.method: X of posed P5; Y of the lower posed axis endpoint (axis midpoint at a=0); Z from foot BRep minimum.

reference_mass.method: Magnitude of ((contact-axis_point)/1000 cross vertical force) dot posed unit axis. Equal load sharing; external vertical contact force only.

support.assumptions: Masses and positions tagged ASSUMED in the parameters drive CoM and support. Shell 229 g is catalog complete-clock mass, assumed fully retained.
support.method: Rectangle axis-aligned margins. Triangle edges oriented counterclockwise; minimum inward signed perpendicular edge distance, negative outside.

independent_estimates.derivation: For direct, with theta=c/2 and a fixed: P5z=z1+s*d*sin(a)-(L1+L2+radius)*cos(theta)*cos(a). Foot bbox minimum=P5z-(D/2)*abs(sin(a))-radius*abs(cos(a)). All reported heights and solves use BRep bounding boxes, not this estimate.

construction_notes: J2 case clamped between the carrier end plates is the tie. No carrier_web.
No upper_web; no lower_web. Direct knee case is the lower-frame shank.
Proximal foot axial midpoint is offset from P5 by its asymmetric prescribed span; centroid formula includes that measured offset.

hip.P1_provenance: design-session placement: J1 case lying flat inside the base (W vertical), 1 mm clear of each base plate, 1 mm clear of the opposite J1 case at the centreline
hip.j2_dx_provenance: H/2 minus the axis offset, so the flat J2 case is centred on x1 and is held by its two end faces between the carrier plates
hip.d_provenance: smallest outboard offset (0.5 mm steps) at which the innermost leg plate clears the J1 case's outboard corner by the clearance while the carrier spreads: sqrt(11^2 + 10^2) + 1.5 = 16.4 mm from the J1 axis

links.length_provenance: equal links for both knee variants; 30 mm keeps the shank's knee case clear of the J2 case's near-end corner for a thigh swinging forward of vertical
links.density_provenance: assumed printed polymer for plates, hubs and channels; not selected

knee.transmission_provenance: proposed GT2-class pulley and belt envelopes and a 5 mm shaft with flanged-bearing envelopes; nothing selected

foot.density_provenance: assumed elastomer roller; a round foot keeps the contact point under the foot axis whatever the shank angle; passive tilt seat not modelled
